hotels.about: Super Hotel O Vemulawada Temple (Formerly Kamakshi Bliss) is a budget-friendly hotel located approximately a 7-minute walk from Sri Raja Rajeshwara Swamy Temple. The hotel offers comfortable air-conditioned rooms with modern amenities including free Wi-Fi, power backup, room service, elevator access, and housekeeping. It is listed on OYO, MakeMyTrip, Goibibo, and Booking.com, making it a convenient choice for pilgrims, families, couples, and budget travelers.
